drive.description: Drive identifier such as drive8, drive9, or unit name defined in the Ultimate UI.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the disk image to mount or manage.

description:
Drive operations available via the c64_drive tool.

Operations:
- reset [write]: Issue an IEC reset for the selected drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- power_on [write]: Power on a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- power_off [write]: Power off a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- load_rom [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Temporarily load a custom ROM into an Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive, path.
- set_mode [write]: Set the emulation mode for a drive slot (1541/1571/1581). Required inputs: drive, mode.
